document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Changing position, a member of your party shakes the bush 
next to you. The dance below stops. One of the little people 
points directly at your hiding place. He shouts something 
that  causes  the  flying  crustaceans  to  scuttle  off  into  the 
woods. The other dancers grab for their weapons. You drag 
the students into flight.
